family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal domain found in Meiotically up-regulated gene 135 protein from Schizosaccharomyces pombe (Mug135, also known as Tdk1, O74876) and similar fungal proteins that are annotated as meiotically up-regulated gene products. Mug135 is a killer meiotic driver (KMD), a selfish genetic element that by selectively kills meiotic products lacking its gene, thereby promoting its own propagation. This protein exists in a nontoxic tetrameric form during vegetative growth and meiosis but transforms into a distinct toxic form in spores [[cite:PUB00159004],[cite:PUB00159007]]. These proteins generally contain a long coiled-coil region with this domain found at the C-terminus.
family.name: Mug135-like, C-terminal domain
